samples.generated_text: <TITLE> Explainable Artificial Intelligence for Healthcare Decision Support <SUBJECT> Artificial Intelligence <ABSTRACT> The emergence of AI agents is a key component for AI research, and its effectiveness can be a pivotal task in developing new AI models. However, the complexity of these agents is more difficult to interpret or evaluate and improve the safety of decision-making. In this work, we propose a framework that combines three novel algorithms for modeling various natural language processing tasks. First, we construct several key techniques that are based on their ability to learn to estimate the uncertainty of the model's own behavior during the agent. Second, we provide a first efficient approach to the exploration of a neural network with different uncertainty levels. Secondly, we show that the proposed method is able to generalize a sequence model and can effectively extract both the input and the features of each model. Then, we demonstrate how the performance of our approach can achieve better performance on real world datasets, and show empirically the benefits of our method to train a range of deep reinforcement learning models. <END>
